clauses.quote: Teachers with less than three (3) years service shall receive thirteen (13) days;
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with less than three (3) years service

clauses.quote: Teachers with three (3) but less than fifteen (15) years of service shall receive twenty (20) days;
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with three (3) but less than fifteen (15) years of service

clauses.quote: Teachers with fifteen (15) or more years of service shall earn twenty-six (26) days.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers with fifteen (15) or more years of service

clauses.quote: A request for the use of general or annual leave (Application for Leave) shall be given to the Supervisor or his/her designee at least one (1) day prior to the expected absence.
clauses.subject_text: A request for the use of general or annual leave (Application for Leave)
clauses.notes: Passive construction imposes duty on teacher to submit request.

clauses.quote: The unavailability of the application form at the school shall not be a reason for denial of leave.
clauses.subject_text: The unavailability of the application form at the school
clauses.notes: Impersonal subject; functions as relief from duty/protection against denial.

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be granted up to a total of four (4) days of leave (in addition to sick leave) during each school year without loss of pay or benefits for funeral or bereavement purposes.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is the district granting leave.

clauses.quote: Administrative leave shall be granted to a Teacher when it is necessary for the Teacher, in a major hardship case, to use time during the school day to seek redress under the terms of this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is the district.

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be carried in a leave without loss of pay status when summoned to serve as a juror on a petit or grand panel, or to appear in court as a subpoenaed witness in their official capacity, or on behalf of federal, state, or municipal governments.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is the district maintaining pay status.

clauses.quote: The Teacher shall furnish his/her Supervisor with a copy of the summons within twenty-four (24) hours of his/her receipt of the summons.
